'''Tarubo Bunzo''' was a [[Dyplotid]], [[Gender|male]] trade representative of [[Astantu Distillery]] of the [[Ring of Kafrene]]. He had brought his finest samples to convince [[Dryden Vos]] to work with him. Bunzo was present in the ''[[First Light]]'' when [[Han Solo]] met [[Qi'ra]] again.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarubo Bunzo first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
